title: Moirs
description:
《About》《Moirs》is a 7 Keys rhythm game, step into the world of music and enjoy the journey!
《Features》• 3+4 Keys, Sky notes and Ground notes test your hand-eye coordination.

• 7 original songs with their respective, elaborate background visuals.

• 4 kinds of difficulty, having a relaxing or challenging game play.

• As songs unlock, the story of a girl chasing her music dream unfolds, and your game play decides the ending.

• Development diary and mini-game with lots of memes (?)
